Job Overview:
The Lead, Security Access Admin role will be responsible for supporting the Identity and Access Management and Security Operations initiatives for the APAC region. The primary responsibilities include authentication, authorization, access management and event monitoring in Support of Global Information Security functions that include, but are not limited to, Entra ID, Azure, Active Directory and SAP. In addition to working closely with IT and the Business, regular interaction with internal and external auditors, Legal, Privacy and Ethics is also required of the position.
Responsibilities:

• Support access management life cycles and governance around active directory, SAP, and any other applications

• Support the federation and single sign technologies

• Develop an understanding of Newell Brands current and forward-looking threat profile

• Monitor and report on the identity threat landscape

• Document and escalate incidents that may cause ongoing and immediate impact

• Documenting expiring credentials and managing communications to stake holders

• Support the Privileged Access Management (PAM) program by enforcing least‑privilege and just‑in‑time access controls, and partnering with infrastructure, and application teams.

• Administer SAP user access across ECC, BW, APO, and related systems, including provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning in alignment with global security standards and least-privilege principles.

• Design, build, and maintain SAP roles using PFCG, ensuring Segregation of Duties (SoD) compliance and proper organizational-level restrictions.

• Analyze and resolve authorization issues using SU53, ST01, SUIM, AGR tables, and related tools; identify root causes of recurring access issues and implement sustainable solutions.

• Support SAP security activities during system implementations, including security blueprinting, role mapping, role build and transport coordination, UAT support, and post-go-live hyper care.

• Triage and resolve security tickets, including access requests, authorization failures, GRC workflow issues, and user lock/expiration troubleshooting, while meeting established SLAs.

• Provide audit and compliance support by generating user access reports, role change documentation, Firefighter logs, and SoD risk analysis, partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, and Compliance teams during control reviews and remediation efforts.

Qualifications:

• (Preferred) Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field

• 5+ years of experience in Information Technology

• 2+ years of experience performing Information Security related duties

• Strong problem solving and communication skills

• Experience in SAP GRC Access Controls, AskIT/AnswerIT, Single Sign-on (SSO), Windows Active Directory, Cloud Solutions, Entra ID, Azure, IGA

• Ability to support multiple projects, shifting priorities, and changing environments/landscapes

• Demonstrates initiative and the ability to perform with limited supervision

• Customer service oriented

The Senior MLOps Engineer treats ML systems as software systems and owns the path from a trained model to a production endpoint that meets its latency, cost, and reliability budgets - across both batch scoring (SageMaker Batch Transform, Snowflake Cortex / Snowpark ML, dbt-orchestrated scoring) and real-time inference (SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock, sub-second feature serving). The Senior Engineer builds the platform that data scientists and ML engineers ship on: feature store with guaranteed online/offline parity, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift and quality monitoring, champion/challenger and shadow deployment scaffolding. This requires a software-engineering-first mindset - distributed systems, observability, and on-call instincts are the foundation; ML literacy makes them effective for this role. GenAI integration experience is a plus, not a requirement.
Responsibilities
ML Production Platform

• Stand up and operate BetMGM 's ML platform on AWS (SageMaker Training, Model Registry, Pipelines, Endpoints, Batch Transform) and Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), with Terraform-managed infrastructure.

• Build self-service scaffolds that let data scientists ship a model end-to-end without a ticket queue - cookie-cutter project templates with CI, drift monitoring, alerting, IaC, and Snowflake connectivity pre-baked.

Batch and Real-Time Inference

• Design and operate batch scoring pipelines - SageMaker Batch Transform, dbt-orchestrated scoring against Snowflake, Snowpark ML - with explicit freshness and cost SLAs.

• Design and operate real-time inference paths - SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock for GenAI, API Gateway - with stated latency budgets (typically sub-100ms) and graceful degradation under load.

• Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity - training-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff.

CI/CD and Deployment Patterns

• Build CI/CD for ML - model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature → training run → deployed model → live prediction.

• Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project.

Monitoring, Drift & Reliability

• Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor - pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it.

• Own MLOps incident response - production model failures are SEV events with postmortems.

Cost and Performance

• Right-size endpoints, batch caching, request batching, and autoscaling. State cost-per-prediction targets up front and meet them.

description:
Job Summary
Job Summary
Lead VHA Contract Coder
Location: Remote
Serves as working lead responsible for outpatient and/or inpatient facility coding, audits, and coding team oversight in support of the VA Portland Health Care System (VAPORHCS). This position is part-time with flexible hours, ideal for a credentialed VHA coder seeking supplemental work.
Primary Responsibilities

• Perform outpatient and/or inpatient facility coding including ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT/HCPCS, DRG, and E&M for all encounters assigned by VAPORHCS

• Access and review health record documentation in VA's VistA/CPRS system; enter codes into the approved coding application

• Apply modifiers, CCI bundling guidelines, and Reason Not Billable (RNB) designations as appropriate

• Code all standard cases within 7 calendar days of receipt/discharge; priority cases within one business day

• Clarify conflicting, ambiguous, or nonspecific documentation; consult VHA coding guidance as appropriate.

• Comply with all HIPAA, VA/VHA privacy, security, and records management directives, and complete all required VA training prior to system access and annually thereafter

• Comply with AHIMA Standards of Ethical Coding

• Conduct coding audits covering not less than 5% of coded services; provide written feedback to team members, track quality trends, and report metrics to Arrow ARC PM on a weekly cadence

• Ensure team coding production meets contract and program office standards, including a minimum of 70 outpatient or 13 inpatient encounters per coder per 8-hour day, and a 95% accuracy rate per HIMS program office requirements

• Serve as primary point of contact for contract team coding questions and VA coding-related inquiries, including documentation clarification, VHA policy, and contract compliance matters

• Mentor and support coders transitioning into VA/VHA coding environments; assist with onboarding and ongoing education as needed

• Participate in VA-directed coding reviews, pre-bill re-reviews, or RAC/MAC audits as applicable

Minimum Qualifications

• Active coding credential from AHIMA (RHIA, RHIT, CCS, or CCS-P) or AAPC (CPC or CPC-H); credential must be maintained for the duration of the contract

Join the Nordic Startup with a 25-Year Legacy 
We are expanding the ITQ team across the Nordics, and we are operating with the agility and energy of a startup, but backed by the stability of a highly respected company that started 25 years ago in the Netherlands.
As a premier VMware Pinnacle Partner, ITQ maintains a laser focus on VMware technology. In a changing market, our exclusive specialization means we are the trusted, go-to partner for high-profile customers and the most complex engagements. If you are deeply passionate about technology and want to work with the absolute best in the industry, this is your safe harbor and your launchpad.
About the role  
As an SDDC Consultant, you will dive straight into a massive, ready-to-go pipeline of technical projects. You will support our clients in transforming traditional datacenters into modern, flexible, and efficient software-defined environments. You jump in and save the day by simplifying complex datacenter infrastructures, reducing costs, and improving overall performance.
While you might be one of the first on the ground in your country, you will never be a "lone wolf." You will operate remotely with high autonomy, while being fully backed by our powerful virtual network of top-tier European experts.
Your responsibilities and technologies:

• You have a solid background in technologies such as VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), VCF Operations, VMware NSX, and Red Hat OpenShift.

• You are hands-on with Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) solutions; practical experience here is essential.

• You possess architectural skills related to SDDC and have a strong understanding of x86 virtualization, operating systems, and advanced networking/storage.

• You are driven by a passion for technology. While current certifications are a plus, a proven track record is what matters most-along with a strong willingness to pursue further certifications once you join.

Who you are:

• You have 5+ years of experience in IT consultancy, engineering, or architecture.

• You are highly self-dependent, proactive, and excited about the "startup mentality" of building a local culture from the ground up.

• You are fluent in English AND at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish).

• You’re passionate about technology; maybe even a bit obsessed (we like that).

Working at ITQ offers some awesome perks  
We don’t just see you as an employee, but as a whole person. You’ll get the freedom, trust, and support to develop in the way that suits you best.

• Ultimate Flexibility: Flexible working hours and location, work from where you are best, as long as customer requirements are fulfilled.

• Solid Foundation: A highly competitive salary package, including a robust pension plan.

• Continuous Growth: An annual training & certification budget, including fully funded certifications to keep you at the top of your game.

• The ITQ Culture: Built on Passion, Authenticity, Ownership, and Quality. Comprehensive onboarding at our HQ in the Netherlands, followed by an informal lunch or dinner with your internal "buddy."

• # ITQ life: Collaboration with top experts, regular knowledge sessions, global networking opportunities, and our legendary annual team weekend.

title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Finance Manager within our Business Unit FP&A team, you’ll play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, and strategic decision-making for Everpure’s subscription business. In this highly visible individual contributor role, you’ll own global top-line forecasting and financial modeling while partnering closely with Business Unit, Product, GTM, Operations, and Accounting leaders to understand performance and guide business decisions.

You’ll combine deep financial expertise with a strong understanding of subscription business models to translate complex data into clear insights, strengthen how we forecast and measure the business, and help leaders make informed decisions as Everpure continues to scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own Global Subscription Forecasting & Financial Modeling: Lead global top-line forecasting across pipeline, bookings, revenue, and margin, while developing and maintaining P&L and capex models. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure operational forecasts align with reported financial results.

• Turn Business Performance Into Strategic Insights: Analyze key subscription metrics including ARR, bookings, retention, churn, expansion, and gross margin. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear insights, compelling visuals, and executive-level narratives that inform business decisions.

• Serve as a Strategic Finance Partner: Partner with Business Unit, Product, GTM, Pricing, Operations, and Accounting leaders to evaluate business performance, strategic initiatives, pricing strategies, and investment opportunities. Support monthly business reviews, quarterly forecasts, annual planning, and long-range planning processes.

• Build Scalable FP&A Tools & Reporting: Design and automate forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and accuracy. Develop dashboards and self-service reporting capabilities, partnering with Data Engineering and Business Systems teams to strengthen data quality and reporting infrastructure.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Significant experience supporting a subscription, SaaS, recurring revenue, or consumption-based business, with a strong understanding of metrics such as ARR, bookings, revenue, retention, churn, expansion, and gross margin.

• Advanced financial analysis and modeling skills, including expertise in Excel and experience developing and maintaining complex P&L, forecasting, and investment models.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial and operational data into clear business insights, executive-ready presentations, and actionable recommendations.

• Strong business partnership and communication skills, with a track record of building relationships and influencing stakeholders across Finance and cross-functional organizations.

• Experience developing dashboards or financial reporting in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools is a plus.

• Experience in technology and/or Corporate FP&A, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting is a plus.

• A strong academic foundation in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Location Expectation: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other

title: Ministry Partner Development Coach
description:
Be Part of Something Eternal

Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ . At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world-workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.

If you’re passionate about mobilizing the Church for global mission and equipping leaders to fulfill the Great Commission, this role is for you.

Empower. Partner. Sustain

As a Ministry Partner Development (MPD) Coach, you’ll equip, encourage, and walk alongside field workers as they build and maintain a team of prayer and financial partners. This role supports workers both before deployment and while on the field and home staff, providing them with resources and encouragement to help them stay fully funded as they pursue their calling.

At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to bring the Gospel to the least-reached Muslim peoples. Our workers serve in some of the most challenging places on earth-and they need strong, grace-filled support to thrive. That’s where you come in.

About the Role

As MPD Coach , you will:

• Provide one-on-one coaching for new appointees in the support-raising process.

• Train candidates in biblical and practical approaches to raising support.

• Assist in developing individualized MPD plans with goals, timelines, and accountability structures.

• Review communication materials (e.g., newsletters, presentations, support letters).

• Encourage perseverance and spiritual resilience during the support-building phase.

• Collaborate with the FieldPrep department to provide resources for Candidate School as needed.

• Provide ongoing MPD coaching and encouragement to missionaries serving cross-culturally.

What We’re Looking For

• A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions

• 3 - 5 years’ experience with personal fundraising or coaching others in support development.

• Excellent relationship builder and team player who can collaborate effectively with all levels of the organization

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills-able to encourage, motivate, and coach.

• Deep understanding of the spiritual, emotional, and practical dimensions of support raising.

• Cross-cultural ministry experience.

• Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple relationships and responsibilities.

• Ability to raise and maintain personal support

Why Join Frontiers ?

When you join Frontiers , you become part of a grace-filled, mission-driven community that:

•
Prioritizes the least-reached - We focus on Muslim peoples with no sustainable Gospel witness.

•
Catalyzes movements - Everything we do contributes to planting healthy, reproducing churches.

•
Empowers teams - Our teams serve with a common vision and freedom to pursue locally appropriate strategies.

•
Values lifelong learning - We are dedicated to coaching, mentoring, and continuous growth.

•
Operates with integrity - Decisions are made by those closest to the action, ensuring effectiveness and accountability.

This job posting is a summary of the position. A full description will be provided during the recruiting process.
